title: server.restart (platform → host)
description: Disruptive (see server.stop). After the restart the host also sends host.health {event: restarted}. Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id). Rejected with `expired` when expires_at is past, and with `stale` when the envelope ts is more than 5 min off the host's clock (a command replayed long after it was sent is not run).
